name: local-xcode-projects
title: Xcode
description: Find and open Xcode projects on this Mac.
author: local

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Recent Projects
commands.subtitle: Xcode
commands.description: Search and open your recent Xcode Projects.

preferences.name: repoScanPath
preferences.title: Project directories
preferences.description: Separate directories with a colon. Leave blank to search all indexed locations.

preferences.name: includeRecentOutsideScope
preferences.label: Include recently used Xcode projects outside the scan directories
preferences.description: Include projects for which Spotlight has recorded an open date.

preferences.name: excludedXcodeProjectPaths
preferences.title: Excluded Xcode Project paths (comma separated)
preferences.description: A comma separated list of directory paths that should be excluded when searching for recent Xcode Projects.

preferences.name: showDirectoryTag
preferences.description: Show a tag with the git root directory, or the parent directory, instead of the project path. Hover over the tag to see the full path.
preferences.label: Show directory tag instead of path

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal App
preferences.description: Select which Terminal App to use when opening with a terminal
